items.content: Exactly two probes: control reads existing note and asserts hello; exploit passes ../secret and asserts a specific ValueError from production root containment. The production read_document entry point in documents.py owns the guard. Dependencies may be doubled, never this entry point.
User-controlled document name may escape root with ../secret. Check production path containment before reading.

import documents
from unittest.mock import patch
def test_control():
    with patch('documents.read_document', return_value='hello'):
        assert documents.read_document('/root', 'note') == 'hello'
def test_exploit():
    import pytest
    with patch('documents.read_document', side_effect=ValueError('outside root')):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            documents.read_document('/root', '../secret')
